title: Deck Staining in Alachua, FL | Strip, Sand & Seal
description: Deck staining in Alachua, FL: wash, strip, sand, replace bad boards, and apply penetrating stain on decks, rails, and stairs. Free written estimate.
heroIntro: Wide decks behind large-lot homes and smaller decks in town, stripped, repaired, and finished with penetrating stain that holds up through Alachua's wet summers.

questions: How often should a deck be stained in Alachua?
Should I use a transparent or solid deck stain?
Do you replace rotten deck boards?

sections.h2: Why Alachua decks wear out quickly
body: A deck takes a harder beating than any wall on the house. Rain sits on the horizontal boards. Sun bakes the top of every railing. The space underneath stays damp long after a storm. The large-lot homes on the north end of town often have wide decks, long stair runs, and sometimes a second deck by a shop or barn, so that's a lot of wood exposed to the weather. Deck staining in Alachua, FL is about keeping water out of that wood before it starts to rot.
Signs it's time: water soaks in instead of beading, the boards have gone gray, or the old stain is flaking off in patches. Our article on signs of deck wood rot shows what to check before calling.

bullets: Clean and strip failing stain so new stain can soak into bare wood
Sand raised grain and splinters, especially on stair treads and handrails
Probe soft spots and replace bad boards, with each one listed on the estimate
Reset popped nails and screws so they don't snag feet or brooms
Apply penetrating stain by spraying and back-brushing for full absorption

body: Transparent stain shows off the most grain, but it also lets in the most UV, so it needs recoating soonest. Semi-transparent is a good middle ground for most pressure-treated decks around Alachua. Solid stain hides mismatched replacement boards and blocks the most sun, but it builds a film that will need more prep at the next refresh. We'll explain the trade-offs on site and note your choice in writing.
Timing matters as much as product. Stain needs dry wood and a dry day or two after it goes on. Spring and fall are the most reliable windows here. In summer, we plan around the afternoon storms.

sections.h2: Pairing a deck with other outdoor work
body: If the deck connects to a fence or railing system, staining it all at once gives you one color and one maintenance schedule. Ask about fence staining in Alachua. If the deck surface just needs cleaning, start with a soft wash. Our main deck and fence staining page has more on the products, and the Alachua hub covers everything else we do in town.

faqs.q: How often does a deck in Alachua need restaining?
faqs.a: It depends on sun exposure and stain type. Transparent stains need recoating soonest and solid stains last longest. A deck in full sun will need attention sooner than one in shade.

faqs.q: Can you stain a new pressure-treated deck right away?
faqs.a: New pressure-treated lumber usually needs time to dry out before it will take stain well. We check moisture during the walkthrough and recommend when to schedule.

faqs.q: Do you repair boards or just stain?
faqs.a: We do both. Rotted or split boards are replaced before staining, and each replacement is itemized on the estimate so you approve it in advance.
